paul-mitchell-tea-tree-hair-and-body-moi.name: Paul Mitchell Tea Tree Hair and Body Moisturizer (10.14 Fl Oz / 300 mL)

Step 2: Facial Active Defense — Apply 5 drops of Obagi Medical Professional-C Serum 20% to face and neck to neutralize environmental free radicals and brighten skin tone.
Step 3: Lightweight Facial Calming — Follow with Beekman 1802 Bloom Cream to balance skin microbiome flora without competing with your hair styling products.
Step 4: Broad-Spectrum UV Defense — Shield skin from photo-damage with non-comedogenic EltaMD UV Clear Broad-Spectrum SPF 46 with Zinc Oxide.
